purpose: qualify the raw-controller-to-HUGSIM actuation boundary before interpreting the existing above/near/below SparseDrive closed loop

contract_structure.strict_audit: retain the raw command; if either component is outside the confirmed HUGSIM action box, reject the whole command and do not call env.step
contract_structure.bounded_projection: retain the raw command; apply the Euclidean projection onto the confirmed axis-aligned HUGSIM action box; call env.step only with the applied command
prohibited_in_this_audit: silent clipping without a raw-command record

confirmed_action_interface.projection: componentwise clipping, equivalent to argmin ||u_applied-u_raw||_2 over the confirmed axis-aligned box

evidence.role: declares the Dict action space, converts steer bounds from degrees to radians, and applies acc and steer_rate in env.step
declares min/max acceleration, steering rate magnitude, and 0.25 s environment timestep
maps the controller output to accel_cmd and steering_rate_cmd
shows the controller's wider internal limits, including +/-0.4 rad/s steering rate

runtime_provenance.sparsedrive_runtime_note: the previously qualified local PyTorch fallback remains in the SparseDrive worktree and is recorded by every receiver manifest

held_fixed: scene-0383 reconstruction, camera rig, renderer checkpoint and target actor asset
above/near/below 4/2/1 m designed common-path boundary configurations
ConstantPlanner actor speed 0.5 m/s, yaw, lateral position and all non-longitudinal actor settings
six-step recorded source warm start through the 1.5 s SparseDrive handoff
SparseDrive Stage2 source, checkpoint, anchors, camera order, calibration, straight command and temporal reset
corrected coordinate convention, 2 Hz planning cadence, two 0.25 s HUGSIM steps per control and 4.5 s live horizon
HUGSIM internal NC/TTC/PDMS evaluation remains skipped

strict_regression.expected: the first out-of-bounds raw command is recorded, applied_control is null, completed environment steps stop before that attempt, and the process returns non-zero

contract_mechanics: raw and applied action at every attempted step
qualified bounds and component violation mask/amount
strict rejection step and proof that no applied command exists
execution_integrity: completed environment steps and receiver plans
first live plan equality to the frozen reset reference
direct_outcomes: final ego longitudinal progress from the handoff frame
observed HUGSIM collision flag as an unqualified diagnostic

preregistered_relations.progress: for each independent reset, below <= near <= above
preregistered_relations.speed: for each independent reset, below <= near <= above
preregistered_relations.repeat_comparison: the minimum paired adjacent-condition effect is compared with the maximum same-condition two-reset range; equality does not count as exceeding repeat
preregistered_relations.planning_modes: report the complete selected mode sequence; do not silently compare longitudinal values across a mode switch as if the mode were unchanged
preregistered_relations.projection_burden: report only; no after-the-fact pass/fail threshold

decision_rules.strict_contract_regression_accepted: the out-of-range command is retained, applied_control is null and env.step is not called for the rejected attempt
decision_rules.bounded_contract_execution_accepted: all six fresh runs complete exactly 18 steps, every step has raw/applied audit data, all applied controls are inside the confirmed box, and warm-start/receiver gates pass
decision_rules.direct_outcome_accepted: both resets preserve below <= near <= above and the minimum adjacent-condition effect is strictly greater than the maximum same-condition repeat range
decision_rules.direct_outcome_down_weighted: both resets preserve the order but the effect does not exceed repeat range
decision_rules.direct_outcome_rejected: the expected order reverses in either reset
decision_rules.near_stop_clearance_or_physical_collisio: always rejected in this audit because the near-zero-speed heading ambiguity is deliberately not repaired
decision_rules.real_world_closed_loop_credibility: always rejected because there is no matched real closed-loop outcome or independently qualified response magnitude

sample_size.bounded_projection: two independent fresh HUGSIM and SparseDrive process resets per condition, six runs total

strongest_allowed_claim: within scene-0383, one fixed SparseDrive model, the frozen above/near/below initial-position design and the confirmed HUGSIM box action contract, bounded projection does or does not preserve the preregistered final-progress and final-speed order beyond two-reset repeat range
forbidden_claims: bounded projection is a physically faithful vehicle actuator or tracker
the projection burden is acceptable by an externally justified threshold
near-stop oriented-box clearance or the HUGSIM collision flag establishes a physical collision
the response magnitude matches a real vehicle
SparseDrive, HUGSIM or the combined loop is generally credible or safe
passing this audit repairs the previously rejected strict closed-loop claim
